decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (100905/GF03/L001, 100905/GF03/L002, 100905/GF03/ESITE, 100905/GF03/PSITE, Site Plan received 07/10/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 9am to 11.30pm Monday to Saturday and 9am to 10pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays.
description: Use of Unit 3 as A3 restaurant in conjunction with existing restaurant use (kiosk unit). Installation of mezzanine floor, use of pavement area for outdoor seating.
